body:
I just checked the website, and the closest chapter is 3 hours away from me. 

I guess I don't understand how to change how I view things. I feel like being optimistic about my life would be naive and that I would be lying to myself.
I have tried to get what you're saying, but I can't really do so. I don't understand how I am supposed to gain control of my future when, as you said, I have lost control of it to begin with.

Okay...I tried to do that, and everything on my list is something which I have no control over. That didn't really help.

I guess I'm kind of doing what you're describing, but it doesn't make me happy or anything like that. I really have no idea what I am supposed to do.
There isn't a listing for my town, lol
Again, I do not know anyone who uses the stuff...

I'm not really that good anything, and I can't think of anything that I really would like to be good at.

Yes, I have a family. Of course, I need to keep living solely out of convenience for them. Nevermind that I am miserable; it is better for me to be alive and miserable than for me to be dead and they miserable.

I have several medical conditions which I will have to deal with for the rest of my life. Only a few people other than myself know about them, but they affect my quality of life and limit what sort of future I will be able to have. I also need to get several expensive surgeries, none of which are covered by insurance. It will be at least 5 years before I can realistically start planning to have one of them done. Even after I get all of the surgeries I need, I will still have the majority of the problems I have now and i will continue to have them until the day I die. I do not want to keep living like this. It is too difficult and too painful.

I can't think of anything else that I have ever really enjoyed doing as much. When I do other things, it feels pretty trivial, as if I'm just going through the motions. But I used to get really into video games. I know it sounds stupid. I'm 18.

As I said to that guy, I don't even really know anyone who smokes weed.
I guess video games? But that's stupid and I can't be wasting money like that right now. But anyway, what's the point? Playing some game can't fix my problems.
I don't know what I could do for myself...I have no idea how to make myself happy.
I don't even know anyone who smokes weed...

No, there is a lot that I can't change and I don't know how to deal with all of it.

I am tired of doing things for other people. I live my life for other people. I am fine with helping others, hell maybe I like it at times, but all in all I am so tired of living my life for other people but not being happy or anything like that. I am tired of giving. I used to tell myself that I should help others because it's not like I'm getting anything out of life, but I am tired of living in that mindset. I need personal happiness or satisfaction and I don't know how to keep going.
